# dayloop v0.12.0-rc8 — P5R visual polish review build

This prerelease is an installable candidate for reviewing the P5R action buttons and the new Confidant, Deadline, and Day Complete artwork on a real device.

## What changed since rc7

- Restored the P5R-themed BACK button treatment used by CHECK ALL while preserving its RC7 size.
- Restored the P5R-themed END DAY treatment used by the TASKS ribbon while preserving its RC7 size.
- Anchored Confidant-index face strips to the right side and retained the dark text-readability gradient.
- Added the supplied Kasumi artwork to the previously missing Faith Confidant entry.
- Added the supplied Deadline artwork to the Today deadline header, fitted and right-anchored behind a readability gradient.
- Added the supplied Day Complete artwork to the perfect-day card, fitted and right-anchored without obscuring its text.

## What to check

- Confirm BACK and END DAY retain the same width and height as RC7 while using their restored P5R treatments.
- Scroll the Confidants index and confirm faces stay on the right without colliding with Arcana or rank text.
- Confirm Faith now shows Kasumi's graphic.
- Check short and long deadline names against the Deadline artwork.
- Complete every task and confirm the Day Complete text stays readable over its artwork.
- Confirm Settings reports `Dayloop v0.12.0-rc8`.

## Candidate APK notes

- This APK is **not production-signed**. It uses Android's standard debug signing key for hands-on testing.
- Its application id is `com.shadowmonarchbooks.dayloop.candidate`, so it can be installed alongside the production Dayloop app.
- Its profiles, progress, and settings are separate from the stable app.
- Version: `0.12.0-rc8` (`versionCode 21`).

_Fan-made tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by ATLUS/SEGA._
